description: This file implements the standard mathematical library for Lua, including mathematical functions (abs, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, floor, ceil, fmod, modf, sqrt, log, exp, deg, rad, min, max, type), random number generation, and some deprecated functions. It defines the 'luaopen_math' function to register the library and its functions.

methods.name: math_abs
methods.description: Calculates the absolute value of a number or integer.

methods.name: math_sin
methods.description: Calculates the sine of a number.

methods.name: math_cos
methods.description: Calculates the cosine of a number.

methods.name: math_tan
methods.description: Calculates the tangent of a number.

methods.name: math_asin
methods.description: Calculates the arcsine of a number.

methods.name: math_acos
methods.description: Calculates the arccosine of a number.

methods.name: math_atan
methods.description: Calculates the arctangent of y/x, with optional x.

methods.name: math_toint
methods.description: Converts a number to an integer if possible.

methods.name: math_floor
methods.description: Calculates the floor of a number.

methods.name: math_ceil
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of a number.

methods.name: math_fmod
methods.description: Calculates the floating-point modulus.

methods.name: math_modf
methods.description: Splits a number into integer and fractional parts.

methods.name: math_sqrt
methods.description: Calculates the square root of a number.

methods.name: math_ult
methods.description: Checks if one integer is less than another as unsigned.

methods.name: math_log
methods.description: Calculates the logarithm of a number with optional base.

methods.name: math_exp
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of a number.

methods.name: math_deg
methods.description: Converts radians to degrees.

methods.name: math_rad
methods.description: Converts degrees to radians.

methods.name: math_min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of multiple values.

methods.name: math_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of multiple values.

methods.name: math_type
methods.description: Returns the type of the number ('integer' or 'float').

methods.name: math_random
methods.description: Generates a random number or integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: math_randomseed
methods.description: Sets the seed for the random number generator.
